qualified_rule.capacity_definition: Evaluate the qualified 5 cm surface face at h_surface=0 and the committed top-node head at t0.
qualified_rule.immediate_ponding_action: Skip the dry full nonlinear soil trajectory and solve the same interval once under ponded/head mode from the unchanged committed state.

B12.negative_control: Original E3G produced a numerically valid but complementarity-inadmissible dry full-step trial; R1 still bypasses that dry trajectory because t0 admission is physically decisive.

interpretation: All four materials pass the corrected initial complementarity admission rule without changing E3G physics, timestep, forcing, tolerances or comparison thresholds.

B12 demonstrates that R1 is not a solver-failure workaround: its original E3G dry predictor was numerically valid, yet R1 correctly bypasses it because the committed-state boundary capacity already makes dry mode physically inadmissible at t0.
B01, O13 and O14 no longer waste a dry nonlinear trajectory against the negative-head upper scope before entering ponded mode.
The original E3G failure remains valid negative evidence about the old ordering and is not overwritten by R1.
R1 only qualifies immediate ponding at t0. A boundary that is dry-admissible at t0 and becomes ponded later inside the interval still requires transactional event localization and a split re-solve.

architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: Mode admission precedes the physical nonlinear trial; no bypassed dry state is published.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: No calendar or midnight semantics introduced.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: Global maximum accepted mass residual is 1.57e-13 cm, below the frozen 1e-9 cm gate, without repair.
architecture_checks.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: Admission is expressed through a surface-face capacity contract, not Richards internals.
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: Physical capacity determines admissibility; solver ordering implements that contract without changing physics.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: Immediate ponding requires zero wasted dry nonlinear trajectories and one ponded trajectory.
architecture_checks.25_reference_mode: Candidate admission and trajectories remain independently checked against reference.
architecture_checks.26_diagnostics_runtime: q_supply, q_cap0, admission classification and nonlinear trajectory counts are explicit.

hard_nonclaims: No finite-time within-step ponding onset event localization is qualified by R1.
No pond-depletion head-to-flux switch is qualified.
No top soil-node h=0 or positive-head state is qualified.
No runoff with real soil state is qualified.
No response tangent across top-boundary switching is qualified.
No production runtime, MultiSWAP, groundwater or MODFLOW admission follows.
